labels.label: bzprop:c3s2p4_automorphisme_compatible
labels.notes: Statement of Benzecri.Sphere.prop4_produit is byte-identical to HEAD (diff of the theorem header through `IsCompatiblePi h.toAut := by`: identical); only the proof changed. Against benzecri1960_ch3.tex:599-605 in Chapter 1's form: universally quantified over every enumeration l : Fin (q+1) ≃ simplesS w and every family of bases b_i : l_i ≅ R^{n_i+1} (>= paper; bases exist, exists_bases_simplesS); conclusion ∃ hB (B_i open), ∃ Ψ : PiBase n B ≃ₜ w with IsProjIso (pdim n) m Ψ, and for every f in GXAut of w, IsCompatiblePi of Ψ⁻¹ f Ψ, with Ψ chosen before f (so one product structure serves all automorphisms, as the paper says). Added hypotheses w.Nonempty and ¬ ContientDroite (F w) are disclosed in the docstring checklist and REPORT, and needed (not_prop4_simplesS_finite, OQ-168/OQ-171 OPEN); the label is unmarked in the docstring (no ** mark) and the curation row is lean_proved_override = partial. IsCompatiblePi (ConverseGeneral.lean:322-335, marked as bzdef:c1s3d2) matches benzecri1960_ch1.tex:806-821 clause by clause: a permutation σ, conical affine isomorphisms φ_i : F(B_σ(i)) ≅ F(B_i), and f ∈ {F⁻¹(φ)} × (R^{+p}/R^+), i.e. an arbitrary t in PiTorus q; allowing any t is therefore Déf. 2 verbatim, not a weakening. The definition is not trivial (σ and the φ_i must be conical isomorphisms of the factors). The finding that t ≠ 1 is needed in general (open segment of S(1), g = diag(1,2), F(B_i) = R_+* whose only GU(1) conical automorphism is the identity, forcing t = [(1,2)]) checks out by hand and is correctly worded as a gap of the printed proof, argued not formalized, not as a falsity. The instance simplexO_prop4_produit is a genuine Lean term: prop4_produit applied to simplexO_hyps4, an enumeration from simplexO_prop4 and bases from exists_bases_simplesS; its axioms are standard.
